TASK: Advisory-only deep-dive (read-only, NO file edits, return analysis as text) on three data-plane details of a Windows-first Tauri client for a low-latency remote-desktop protocol. The protocol: TCP via TLS-PSK (openssl crate, external PSK, identity strings, TLS1.2 PSK ciphersuites — rustls unsupported), UDP datagrams AES-256-GCM (12B nonce = 4B prefix + 8B big-endian counter, direction-separated HKDF keys, 4096-packet sliding replay window), video = HEVC in AVCC-style (4-byte big-endian length-prefixed NALUs, VPS/SPS/PPS prepended to keyframes), 60fps target, decode-to-pixel latency budget ~16ms.

DELIVERABLE — for each of the three, exact API-level design + edge cases:
1. openssl crate TLS-PSK CLIENT on Windows: exact rust-openssl API surface for PSK client callback (set_psk_client_callback or newer API), which PSK ciphersuites to pin for TLS1.2, identity string handling, vendored-openssl build implications on Windows CI (openssl-sys features), and whether Schannel fallback is viable (assume NO — recommend OpenSSL vendored). Edge cases: callback threading, identity encoding (UTF-8 bytes vs null-termination).
2. Replay window port: an incoming datagram's 12-byte nonce embeds an 8-byte counter read as big-endian; window logic = counter >= highestReceived - 4096, duplicate bitmask per 64-block. Design the Rust struct for lock-free-ish single-producer single-consumer use, nonce prefix role, and how to handle counter reuse across reconnects (fresh session keys per reconnect make prefix collision irrelevant — confirm).
3. HEVC decode pipeline: ffmpeg-next (libav bindings) — whether to use hevc decoder with AVCC extradata (mkv/extradata path: set extradata to the VPS/SPS/PPS blob, feed length-prefixed NALUs directly) vs converting to AnnexB per frame; hardware accel choice on Windows (d3d11va via hw_device_ctx) vs software decode fallback for 640x360-4K streams; frame pacing to hit ~16ms decode-to-present; how to get decoded frames into a wgpu texture (zero-copy options: D3D11 texture sharing vs GPU-CPU copy via staging buffer — quantify the copy cost at 4K30).

VERIFY: each design names exact crates/APIs/versions where possible; flag anything uncertain as UNCERTAIN with how to verify.
STOP WHEN: all three sections delivered.
Advisory-only analysis for a planning session — not implementation.
